scope: Actual console DOM and actual fixed-step RoadsterSim replay/A-B. Canvas and asynchronous Worker endpoints are facades; no browser layout, Worker-thread performance, WebGL pixels or FPS evidence.

tests.name: Record button captures actual driving state, physical commands and immutable per-step metrics; JSON-all and CSV-selected have explicit scope
Original-condition 3D replay uses the actual solver and returns to a verified terminal state; replay does not re-run program commands twice
Measurement delay/noise and nozzle derating controls apply public physical APIs and are journaled during a manual experiment
An existing automatic procedure receives a full experiment snapshot and rejected / cancelled outcomes remain available
State restores terminate an old same-scene program and finish any new recorder before importing a different state
A solver fault or terminal-command mismatch during 3D replay retains a failed execution with its actual completed step
Without WebGL the same console disables only live operations while history, numerical replay and explicit controller A/B remain usable
A cancelled numerical Worker execution remains exported with source identity and partial statistics
A synchronous Worker constructor failure preserves the requested A/B identity and gains, clears Run / Stop state, and permits retry
Synchronous request and cancel postMessage failures each leave one failed attempt, terminate the Worker, and remain exportable
Refresh restores the full replayable archive and metadata; history remains visible with live controls disabled
